comparison.objective: Candidate removes one fan module; record isolates a battery pack and removes busbars safely.
comparison.physical_skill: Bracket depression and constrained lift versus ordered service-plug removal and conductive-part handling around terminals.
comparison.success_condition: Fan placed safely for 3 s versus plug out, busbars in tray, electrical-order and terminal-clearance hazards respected, stable for 1 s.
comparison.reason: The record's core ability is hazardous ordered electrical disassembly, not simultaneous latch release and vertical withdrawal.
